# PIANO Developer Wiki

Public, machine-readable onboarding map for contributors and coding agents.

Repository: https://github.com/Piano-Louvor-JA/wiki
Website: https://piano-louvor-ja.github.io/wiki/

## Read first

1. AGENTS.md — contribution rules and safety boundaries
2. architecture/overview.md — multi-device contract model
3. workflows/git-and-prs.md — branch and PR flow

## Repository guides

- getting-started/app.md — native desktop app
- getting-started/api.md — API contracts and migrations
- getting-started/apk.md — Flutter mobile
- getting-started/web.md — browser PWA

## Agentic development

- agentic-dev/prompts.md — baseline audit, contract parity, evidence

## Decisions

- adr/001-ws-proprio-multi-device.md — WebSocket receiver protocol
- adr/003-migrations-idempotentes.md — migration execution

## Invariants

- Feature branches target `staging`; releases go from `staging` to `main`.
- Desktop, web and mobile share contracts, not UI code.
- TV receivers use the project WebSocket protocol; Chromecast and AirPlay are unsupported.
- Do not publish credentials, personal data, private infrastructure or operational records.
